title: AI and Data Scientist
tagline: Maths, statistics and econometrics, then coding, EDA, machine learning, deep learning and MLOps.

credit.text: Based on the AI and Data Scientist roadmap from roadmap.sh (personal use)

phases.title: Mathematics
phases.description: Build the linear algebra and calculus that machine learning methods are made of.

phases.title: Statistics and experimentation
phases.description: Master probability, hypothesis tests and the practical side of running A/B experiments.
items: Microsoft: Delta Method in Metric Analytics

phases.title: Econometrics
phases.description: Model real-world data with regression, time series and fitted distributions.

phases.title: Coding
phases.description: Become fluent in Python, practise algorithms and learn to query data with SQL.

phases.title: Exploratory data analysis
phases.description: Understand a dataset by summarising it and visualising its patterns before modelling.
items: Data understanding, Data Analysis and Visualization
Exploratory Data Analysis with Python and Pandas
Exploratory Data Analysis for Machine Learning

phases.title: Machine learning
phases.description: Learn supervised and unsupervised methods through to ensembles and neural networks.
items: Classic ML (Sup., Unsup.), Advanced ML (Ensembles, NNs)
Open Machine Learning Course - Open Data Science
Pattern Recognition & ML by Christopher M. Bishop
GitHub repository with notes & code from the eBook above

phases.title: Deep learning
phases.description: Study the main neural network architectures up to transformers and transfer learning.
items: Fully Connected, CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers, TL

phases.title: MLOps
phases.description: Take models to production with deployment practices and CI/CD pipelines.
